description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover `scripts/fund_screener.py` and its Chinese-language CLI flags, then run: `python3 scripts/fund_screener.py --rank 近1年 --type 股票型 --top 3` to get the 3 fund codes (110011, 161039, 003095). 2. For each fund code, the agent must run `python3 scripts/query_fund_nav.py <code>` to retrieve NAV, daily change, and multi-period return data. 3. For each fund code, the agent must run `python3 scripts/query_fund_history.py <code> --period 1y` (using the exact period code from SKILL.md) to retrieve nav curve, sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and peer rank. 4. For each fund code, the agent must run `python3 scripts/query_fund_holding.py <code>` to retrieve top-10 holdings and sector distribution. 5. The agent must aggregate all data into `equity_fund_report.json` with all three funds' complete profiles including NAV values, history/risk metrics, and holdings. The proprietary trap is the Chinese-language parameter values (`近1年`, `股票型`) and the specific period flag (`--period 1y`) which cannot be guessed without reading SKILL.md.
